text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking by the academy

entrance...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... still not enough power! But that
was the
final finishing move in my
arsenal...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was trying to muster up some power to
take on
my next race!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could show my face to
my
wrestler papa if I lose in a battle of
strength!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Fate must've brought you
here at just
the right time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You know of any ways to boost power?
Give me
some pointers, por favor!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, interesante! So all I gotta do is
generate the
power from inside my
body, eh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gotta strike while the iron is caliente!
Off to the
cafeteriaaa!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Problem passionately solved! Call
me El
Condor Happy! That's a great
idea!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm muy motivada now! Time to hit the
traaack!
